title: Words of a card, normal layout
description: A words file of a card of the normal layout: data/print/<lang>/card/base/entity/ holds the words every print of the card shows, and a print whose words differ holds its own file at data/print/<lang>/card/<set>/<number>.json. The words sit on the record, as the card holds its characteristics.

history.description: Records of official corrections to these words. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.
